messages:
camille: Quick weekly check for VelaPayments — token usage + throughput snapshot. TL;DR: QoQ tokens +18%, WoW -4%, p50 latency ~138ms, p95 ~420ms, overall errors 1.9% (auth spikes), spend QoQ +12%.
maria: Thanks — do we know if the WoW dip maps to any onboarding cohort churn?
camille: looks like cohort B (onboarded Apr) saw a dip in active sessions. They still have 42% MAU vs 49% for cohort A.
julian: I caught a short queueing event at ~03:20 UTC yesterday. Autoscaler didn't add nodes fast enough; kube events show backoff. Investigating root cause. :mag:
camille: fyi they're on `rdx-large-quant` with auto-batching=on and a small KV cache set. Could be cache pressure + cold-starts.
pradeep: Spend note — billing shows an upward trend driven by token count and p95 tail. If QoQ +12% persists, renewal conversation may surface cost concerns. Flagging for renewals.
maria: Let's schedule enablement: quick best-practices for batching, cache warmers, and retry/backoff. propose Tue 2025-05-13 15:00 UTC. @pradeep can you join for pricing Q&A?
pradeep: can do. I'll prepare a short spend forecast (3-tier scenarios).
ops-bot: ALERT: error-rate > 1.5% for vela-prod between 03:00-04:00 UTC — triggered incident page.
julian: logs show a small auth token issuer outage -> downstream 401s spiked. Ramp back when issuer recovered. I'll add a fallback in the auth client.
camille: action items: (1) julian — add graceful fallback + postmortem notes (2) maria — run enablement & share runbook (3) pradeep — three-tier spend forecast. I'll follow up with Vela CSM and include the QoQ/WoW snapshot.
maria: capturing feedback too — customer asked for clearer per-route cost breakdowns. We'll add that to the enablement deck. :memo:
camille: quick metric dump for thread (paste):
```
Period      Tokens    QoQ%   WoW%
Q1->Q2      1.2M      +18%   -4%
Last 7d     280k      n/a    -4%
Latency p50 138ms
Latency p95 420ms
Errors      1.9%  (auth 0.9%, rate-limit 0.4%, other 0.6%)
Spend (30d) $4,200  (+12% QoQ)
```
julian: noted, I'll attach logs and a short runbook PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team — I'll send invites and copy the customer-facing notes. :eyes:
